summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Iphidamas son of Antenor, whom Agamemnon slew at Troy in the Iliad.

story.text: Apollodorus names Iphidamas among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Marpsius and before Argius in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
